lines.en: born from the lords of the triplicity of the Moon, for the nativity was

lines.text: nocturna. Dominus primus triplicitatis Lunæ fuit
lines.en: nocturnal. The first lord of the triplicity of the Moon was

lines.text: Mars, secundus Venus, tertius Luna, omnes in angu-
lines.en: Mars, the second Venus, the third the Moon, all in the angles

lines.text: regnum, & ideo fuit uir iste magnus, excelsus, & stabi-
lines.en: kingship, and therefore this man was great, exalted, and stable

lines.text: lis in prosperitate, donec corona aurea fuit posita in
lines.en: in prosperity, until a golden crown was placed on

lines.text: caput eius, ac argentea cũ margaritis, & lapidibus pre-
lines.en: his head, and a silver one with pearls, and precious stones,

lines.text: ciosis, ac laus eius fuit in ore omnium hominum.
lines.en: and his praise was in the mouth of all men.

summary.headline: Moon’s Triplicity Lords and Kingship
summary.text: Astrological interpretation of a nocturnal nativity from the Moon’s triplicity lords: Mars, Venus, and the Moon occupy the angles, signifying prosperity, exaltation, kingship, and eventual royal honors.
